answers.answer: Shuffle 12 Speed, 3 Starting Upgrade, and 3 Stress cards into the initial draw deck. Place 6 Heat face up on the Engine. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.
answers.evidence: Setup 4–6, 9: "Shuffle your 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards together"; "Place 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine spot"; "Set Gear pawn to 1st gear"; "Draw 7 cards".

answers.answer: Yes, you may stay. You may shift from 1st to 3rd by immediately paying 1 Heat during Shift Gears, from Engine to discard. You must have the Engine Heat available.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears: "Stay in your current gear"; "shift two positions by immediately paying 1 Heat during this step: move a Heat card from your Engine to your discard pile."

answers.answer: No. You must commit 3 cards face down in 3rd gear.
answers.evidence: Play Cards: "Play cards from hand face down equal to your gear number ... 3rd = 3".

answers.answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous across players, with step 1 before step 2. Step 3 waits until everyone finishes both. Each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next starts step 3. Frontmost acts first; side by side, the car closest to the Race Line acts first.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure and Sequential Phase: "All players complete steps 1 and 2 simultaneously, in that order"; "Each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next player begins step 3"; "the car closest to the Race Line is ahead for all purposes".

answers.answer: Cars never block passage. With the destination full, use the first free spot behind the blocking cars, preferring the spot closest to the Race Line if available.
answers.evidence: Blocked Movement: "Cars never block passage ... first free spot behind the blocking cars." Reveal & Move: "Place your car on the spot closest to the Race Line if available."

answers.answer: Immediately discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade. Put Speed 3 in the Play Area on top of the played Stress, which remains underneath. The Stress supplies speed 3. Discard both during Replenish Hand. Resolve this before Adrenaline.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: "Immediately discard each flipped non-Speed card, including Heat, Stress and Starting Upgrade cards"; "Put the found Speed card in your Play Area on top of the played Stress card"; "Discard both during Replenish Hand"; "Resolve all played Stress cards before moving on to Adrenaline."

answers.answer: The last two cars to move receive Adrenaline. Each gains access to 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed during React. The extra speed can be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: "If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits"; "1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed"; "before or after Boost"; "Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved for another round."

answers.answer: Yes. 2nd gear provides Cooldown 1, so return that Heat from hand to Engine, then immediately spend it from Engine to discard to Boost. React allows these actions in either order.
answers.evidence: Cooldown: "2nd gear (Cooldown 1)". React: "Activate available Cooldown and/or Boost symbols in any order. You may Cooldown Heat from your hand into your Engine, then immediately spend it to Boost."

answers.answer: Boost once per turn during React for 1 Heat from Engine to discard. If Engine is empty, you cannot choose Boost unless available Cooldown first returns Heat from hand. Flip until a Speed card appears, discarding each non-Speed immediately. Put the Speed card in the Play Area and move its value; its speed counts for corners.
answers.evidence: Boost: "Once per turn during React, pay 1 Heat from Engine to discard"; "Flip cards ... immediately discarding each non-Speed card, until you reveal a Speed card"; "Boost increases your total speed for corner checks." Paying Heat requires Engine Heat and permits Cooldown first.

answers.answer: Slipstream is optional. Check speed 6, excluding Slipstream movement. Because you crossed the corner, pay 2 Heat for exceeding limit 4 by 2.
answers.evidence: Slipstream: "optionally move 2 spaces forward. This does NOT increase your speed for corner checks, but crossing a Corner Line this way still requires checking that corner." Check Corner: "pay Heat equal to the excess".

answers.answer: Check both in crossing order: limit 6 first, then limit 4. Use speed 8 for each, paying 2 then 4 Heat, for 6 Heat total.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: "Check every Corner Line crossed ... in the order crossed"; "For each corner separately ... pay Heat equal to the excess"; "Use the same total speed for each corner".

answers.answer: The required cost is 3 Heat, which you cannot pay. Discard both remaining Engine Heat and spin out. Move back to the first available space before that corner, take 2 extra Stress directly into your hand, and set gear to 1st.
answers.evidence: Spin Out: "move all remaining Engine Heat to your discard pile"; "first available space before the corner that caused the spin out"; "directly into your hand"; "2 if you were in 3rd/4th gear"; "move your Gear pawn to 1st gear."

answers.answer: You may optionally discard unwanted Speed cards, but never Stress or Heat. You may not browse your own or another player’s discard pile. Only the top card of each pile is public.
answers.evidence: Discard: "Optionally discard unwanted cards from hand, but never Stress or Heat cards. Nobody may browse any discard pile, including their own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge."

answers.answer: Move all Play Area cards to discard, then draw only enough to bring your hand to seven, not seven additional cards.
answers.evidence: Replenish Hand: "Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7. Do not draw seven additional cards."

answers.answer: Immediately shuffle the discard pile into a new draw deck. Exclude cards still in the Play Area, then continue the interrupted Stress flips.
answers.evidence: Running Out of Cards: "immediately shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck, then continue the interrupted draws or flips"; "This applies during Stress"; "Do not include cards still in your Play Area".

answers.answer: Payment moves Heat from Engine to discard. It can later enter the draw deck, be drawn into hand, and return to Engine only through Cooldown. Normally you cannot play Heat or voluntarily discard it from hand; forced Cluttered Hand handling is an exception.
answers.evidence: Paying Heat: "from your Engine to your discard pile". Heat Card Cycle: "Engine to discard to draw deck to hand; only returns to Engine via Cooldown." "Heat cards cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand".

answers.answer: Commit both playable cards and fill the other two required slots with two Heat cards from hand. Move zero spaces, set gear to 1st, and discard all four committed cards including the Heat. Skip directly to Replenish Hand. You skip React and cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn.
answers.evidence: Cluttered Hand: "commit all playable cards you can and fill the remaining required slots with Heat cards"; "moves zero spaces"; "Set your gear to 1st, discard all committed cards (including the covering Heat cards), and skip directly to step 9"; "You skip React, so cannot Cooldown or Boost".

answers.answer: No. When cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins; closest to the Race Line breaks a side-by-side tie. At round end, remove finished cars and put them in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: "If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins (closest to Race Line breaks ties)"; "At the end of the round, remove all cars that crossed the final finish line".

answers.answer: You may not Slipstream across the final finish line, nor Slipstream after normal movement has crossed it. After crossing that final finish line, ignore speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: "On the final lap, you cannot Slipstream across the finish line, and cannot Slipstream after crossing it"; "ignore the speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can."

answers.answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline: a six-car start qualifies the last two cars to move. Eligibility uses the number of cars that started, even after finishers leave, rather than the number remaining.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: "If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits"; "Use the number of cars that started the race, even after finishers leave the track."
